subject: PetraHealth: Renewal + Burst Capacity Planning — kickoff & QBR poll
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@petrahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PetraHealth: Renewal + Burst Capacity Planning — kickoff & QBR poll

Asha —

Congrats on the progress this quarter and thanks again for the usage readout last week. As we discussed on the call, PetraHealth's current term comes up in late June and there are two things we'd like to align on now so we have a smooth handoff:

1) Capacity uplift request (seasonal burst in Q4) — sizing and SLA expectations.
2) Term and pricing options — stair-step vs flat commit for throughput.

Next steps I propose: I attached a short mutual action plan (spreadsheet) with proposed milestones, and a PDF with three term scenarios. Can you confirm the right procurement contact so we can include them in the DocuSign/PO conversation?

Also, here's a one-click poll to lock a 60‑minute QBR window (includes ops/CS + engineering): https://cal.poll/7h3k-petra-qbr — please pick any 2 slots that work this week.

If helpful, we can pre-populate the term options and send a redline-ready doc before the QBR.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PetraHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Term_Options_3.pdf (PDF)

From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@petrahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ProcuremeNT Team <procurement@petrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PetraHealth: Renewal + Burst Capacity Planning — kickoff & QBR poll

Diego —

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick answers first:
- Procurement contact is procurement@petrahealth.com (cc'd).
- We do expect a seasonal surge Nov–Dec and the team wants predictable latency under load — ops will join the QBR.

I filled out two slots on the poll. Before the QBR, can you share:
- A) cost delta between a seasonal burst add-on vs permanent commit (line-itemed)
- B) any evidence/benchmarks for latency at 10k concurrent tokens/min (our worst-case simulation)

Procurement may pull PO/terms into a separate thread but wants the MA P and a summary memo for legal.

See you on Thursday if the poll holds.

Cheers,
Asha Raman
Senior Product Ops Manager
Petra Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@petrahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@petrahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PetraHealth: Renewal + Burst Capacity Planning — kickoff & QBR poll

Asha / Petra procurement team —

Thanks — adding procurement here is perfect. Attached:
- PetraHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners)
- Redwood_Term_Options_3.pdf (straightforward comparison: seasonal burst add-on, 12‑month stair-step commit, 24‑month discounted commit)
- qbr-calendar-poll.ics (calendar file for proposed times)

Quick answers inline:
A) Cost delta: I included a draft pricing table on page 2 of the PDF showing the per-token and per-hour throughput delta between the three options. Topline: a seasonal burst add-on (~20% uplift for Q4) is ~18% premium vs a flat 12‑month commit. 24‑month commit gets an extra ~9% off that price.
B) Latency evidence: See the "latency_profiles" annex in the PDF — we ran a workload similar to your 10k tokens/min scenario on our dedicated pool with KV caching and saw median p50 token latency of 7ms and p95 of 23ms across 90% of requests (test details included). We'll bring SRE to the QBR for deeper ops detail.

Priyom — I flagged the items I expect you to surface: pricing fallback, DocuSign plan, and any temporary credits should we need them for the QBR pilot.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PetraHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_Term_Options_3.pdf, qbr-calendar-poll.ics

Team —

Quick operational notes ahead of the QBR (Thursday 16:00 PT slot confirmed from poll):
- I'll bring a redline-ready amendment for the chosen term option.
- If procurement can share their standard PO/terms we will pre-fill payment and KVS (customer-specific) fields to speed sign-off.
- If Petra wants an initial 30‑day pilot for the burst-configuration we can scope it (ops runbook + rollback plan) — suggest we agree on SLOs and a one-time credit to cover engineering ramp.

Procurement: can you drop any PO template or preferred billing/legal contacts in reply? I can then kick off the DocuSign envelope (link: https://www.docusign.com/NDx9fJk) and pre-populate the MA P.

See you Thursday.

—Priyom
